scenes.narration: On July 7th, 1881, the steamer Proteus sailed from St. John's, Newfoundland, and turned north toward Greenland. On board was Lieutenant Adolphus Greely's expedition.
On August 11th, she anchored in Discovery Harbor, on Lady Franklin Bay. Eight days later, the Proteus left. Twenty-five men stayed behind.
A relief ship was sent in 1882. The Neptune never reached them.
In 1883, a second relief expedition went north on the Proteus. On July 23rd, she was crushed in the pack ice and sank.
On June 22nd, 1884, the ships Thetis and Bear found seven men alive near Cape Sabine. Seventeen had starved, and one had drowned. Only six came home.
